lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, exhibiting a semi-regular grid-like distribution across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, forming anchor nodes at the intersection points, most visible in the anterior section of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges display a sharp intensity gradient, with high-reflectance upper edges and shadowed lower edges, extending longitudinally along the upper third of the flank.
